method: Original vector masks authored against local museum originals inspected with view_image; shared exact Redouté partition from the S01 collaboration. All runtime alpha geometry follows the original raster plane, before viewport crops.
component_base_alpha: White/black luminance masks are resolved inside an SVG mask to output real transparent holes; the separated component is not duplicated underneath.
